01 — UsChapter I

Two cities, one heart, and a diya that never goes out.

I'm in Delhi, you're in Gurgaon, Rupanshi. Only a few kilometres lie in between, yet sometimes those kilometres feel like the whole world.

This Diwali I wanted to light diyas with you on the rooftop, feed you sweets, and watch the whole city glow in your laughter. Until then, this little website is my rangoli for you, Cutiepiee. Every diya, every flame, only for you.

© 2026 — Only for you Happy Diwali, Cutiepiee Delhi → Gurgaon · Diwali 2026
A letter, only for you

My dearest Cutiepiee Rupanshi,

Happy Diwali, my love. Funny, isn't it? Delhi and Gurgaon are so close, and still I can't light a diya beside you this year. But this distance reminds me, every single day, how special you are to me.

You are the light that turns my ordinary evenings into something special. Your laugh, your voice, the way you scold me so sweetly, none of it is any less than a diya to me. Even when you're not near, it feels like a small flame is burning on my side, and it's yours.

All I want to say this Diwali is this: soon the day will come when this distance is just a story, and we'll light our diyas together on the same rooftop.

Until then, all these diyas, all these lights, this whole sky, every spark, is yours.

Forever yours,
Anurag Singh Thakur ✦

P.S. "Doodh kab pilaoge ab mommy" — you know exactly what I mean 😋
